payload.ai_prompt_keywords: Design an e-ink/paper style interface. Use: high contrast black on off-white, paper texture, no animations (instant transitions), reading-focused, minimal UI chrome, distraction-free, calm aesthetic, monochrome.
payload.best_for: Reading apps, digital newspapers, minimal journals, distraction-free writing, slow-living brands
payload.css_technical_keywords: background: #FDFBF7 (paper white), color: #1A1A1A, transition: none, font-family: serif for reading, no gradients, border: 1px solid #E0E0E0, texture overlay (noise)
payload.do_not_use_for: Gaming, video platforms, high-energy marketing, dark mode dependent apps
payload.effects_and_animation: No motion blur, distinct page turns, grain/noise texture, sharp transitions (no fade)
payload.implementation_checklist: ☐ Paper background color, ☐ High contrast text, ☐ No animations, ☐ Reading optimized, ☐ Distraction-free, ☐ Print-friendly
payload.keywords: Paper-like, matte, high contrast, texture, reading, calm, slow tech, monochrome
